evidence.requirement: No variable-width truncation in this fingerprint API
evidence.implementation: Fingerprint.variants has compile-time type [[u64; 4]; 8]; comparison XORs all four channels. No external decimal string parser used.

evidence.requirement: Nonfinite statistics cannot become informative evidence
evidence.coverage: NaN, positive infinity, negative infinity in each of three RGB fields or standard deviation; both operand directions and transform modes, direct comparison and indexed stored candidate.

evidence.requirement: Equal hashes are insufficient to prove pixel identity
evidence.note: Candidate API deliberately retains zero-distance candidates; consumers must qualify identity separately.

evidence.requirement: Persisted fingerprints reject invalid statistics and separate content/recipe/frame identity

limits: No implementation change necessary for these already covered cases.
Focused default-free tests only; not full decoder/model integration or all-library completion.
